name: memorysync
description: Persistent memory for Codex: hooks capture every exchange and inject recalled context per prompt, with the MemorySync MCP server for search, save, list, update and delete.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic long-term memory for AI coding sessions
interface.longDescription: MemorySync gives Codex durable memory: lifecycle hooks persist every prompt and reply the moment they happen and inject relevant memories at session start and per prompt — scoped to you and your repository, session-safe by contract (memory being down can never break a session). Includes the full MemorySync MCP tool set.
